huahua-spirits 1.4.0 — Major upgrade: detailed documentation, new interaction, and improved companion experience.

- Full SKILL.md overhaul: expanded core features, edge cases, agent triggers, technical tool descriptions, and formatting guidelines.
- Added multi-language support (Chinese/English) for spirit cards and interactions.
- Introduced explicit guidelines for passive and proactive spirit behavior, personality-driven responses, and friendlier agent integration.
- New interaction commands and improved companion growth mechanics (bonding, attribute growth, mood mapping).
- Clarified role boundaries: spirits offer companionship only, never perform tasks or access agent capabilities.
